claim: At score >= 5, the known nuclear transients pass more often than objects in the Unknown stratum.
rationale: Same threshold and stratum as the earlier run recorded in the mission README, applied to an independent sample of weeks. Unknown is most of the real alert stream.
failure_interpretation: On this sample the screen does not separate the known objects from the Unknown stratum. The threshold, stratum and seed will not be changed to recover the claim.
alternative_explanations: Circularity: the known objects were selected by a TDE classifier and by eye, and the threshold was chosen after their scores had been seen. The positive side is in-sample and is not replicated by this run.
Chance: about 12 background objects per stratum.
Sampling: a stratum is the last 3000 alerts of its class in the week, so busy classes cover only the last night, and objects that alert often are over-represented.
Observation effort: detections and duration depend on how often a field was observed.
seen_before_lock: The full results of the earlier run outside the harness (484 background objects, seed 20261123), including the scores of all 23 known objects. Also the results of two small runs made with the first version of this harness (seeds 1101 and 5830417), which were discarded when the decision rule was corrected. No object of this run's weeks.
ai_budget: Maintainer's first live run: one pass through the steps, stop after the gates.
